definitions.short: properly, united , i.e. sole ; by implication, beloved ; also lonely ; (feminine) the life (as not to be replaced)
definitions.full: H3173. yachid יָחִיד adjective and substantive only, only one, solitary (Late Hebrew id. ; Aramaic יְחִידַי יָחִיד, , , , id. ; Arabic solitary ) — 1 only one , especially of an only son, Gen 22:2 , 12 , 16 יְחִידְךָ את בנך את thy son, thine only one , יָחִיד אֵבֶל Amos 8:10 ; Jer 6:26 mourning for an only son , היחיד על כמספד Zech 12:10 ; Prov 4:3 אמי לפני וְיָחִיד רַךְ ; so feminine יְחִידָה Judg 11:34 . 2 feminine יְחִידָה as substantive Psa 22:21 ; 35:17 יְחִידָתִי my only one , poetic for my life , as the one unique and priceless possession which can never be replaced (in each || נַפְשִׁי ). 3 solitary , Psa 25:16 אני ועני יחיד כי ; 68:7 בַּיְתָה יְחִידִים מוֺשִׁיב causing solitary, isolated ones (i.e. friendless wanderers or exiles; || אֲסִירִים ) to dwell at home (Lag Ch and others מֵשִׁיב bringing back home).
